comment: Verdicts of the retained reference analyzer over every variant materials_tests.rs builds: a refusal's code, the class of an error it raised outside its vocabulary, or a passed analysis keeping every key and every value except the certificate and public-key digests, which depend on the keys, and the library versions, which depend on the analyzer. Recorded twice over one dump of the variants and once over a second dump with fresh keys; the three recordings were identical.
